# JBird Bikes

> JBird Bikes is a neighborhood eBike shop at 2336 St. Louis Street, New Orleans, LA 70119, on the Lafitte Greenway. We sell new and pre-owned UL-certified eBikes, eScooters, and eTrikes, assemble and repair eBikes, and buy and take trade-ins on used eBikes. Lease-to-own is available through Snap Finance from $29.99 per week.

We work on electric rides only. We do not sell or repair pedal bikes.

## Contact and hours

- Phone and text: (504) 521-6997
- Address: 2336 St. Louis Street, New Orleans, LA 70119 (on the Lafitte Greenway)
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

## What we offer

- [eBike sales](https://jbirdbikes.com/sales.html): New and pre-owned eBikes, eScooters, and eTrikes. Every bike we sell is UL-certified and assembled in our shop.
- [Brands we carry](https://jbirdbikes.com/aventon-ebikes-new-orleans): Authorized dealer for Aventon, Lectric, Gotrax, Retrospec, Mockwheel, and Vanpowers.
- [Professional eBike assembly](https://jbirdbikes.com/assembly.html): $135 flat rate, any brand, with a 21-point safety check and a free 30-day shakeout tune-up.
- No-Flat tire sealant: $30 add-on.
- [eBike repair](https://jbirdbikes.com/repairs.html): Free diagnostic before any work. Warranty work is done in our shop.
- [Sell your eBike](https://jbirdbikes.com/sell): Free evaluation, then cash or store credit.
- [Trade in your eBike](https://jbirdbikes.com/trade): Put the value toward a new ride.
- [Lease-to-own](https://jbirdbikes.com/apply): Snap Finance, from $29.99 per week, 72 weekly payments, 100-day early payoff option. No credit history required. Not all applicants are approved.
- [FAQ](https://jbirdbikes.com/faq): Common questions about buying, financing, assembly, and repair.

## Policies

- [Returns and warranty](https://jbirdbikes.com/return-policy.html): 30-day return window on new bikes; 30-day labor warranty.
- [Privacy](https://jbirdbikes.com/privacy.html)
